title: Contents Packout & Storage Secured Section Charge for Declared-Value Jobs
content:
Contents Packout & Storage jobs carrying declared-value coverage are kept in the secured section. For the vault storage billed to the customer on a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job: **when the largest declared value shown on the job's declared-value coverage lines is at least the secured-section threshold, each vault charged carries the high secured-section add; when that declared value is above zero but below the secured-section threshold, each vault charged carries the low secured-section add; a job with no declared-value coverage line carries no secured-section add.**

## Secured-section adds

| Largest declared value shown on the job's declared-value coverage lines | Add carried by each vault charged |
|---|---|
| 20000.00 or more (at least the secured-section threshold) | 22.00 (high add) |
| above 0.00 and below 20000.00 | 12.00 (low add) |
| no declared-value coverage line on the job | none |

The declared value read is the largest one shown on the declared-value coverage lines already booked on the job.

## Boundary cases

- Largest declared value shown 20000.00: at least the threshold, so 22.00 per vault.
- Largest declared value shown 19,999.99: above zero and below the threshold, so 12.00 per vault.
- No declared-value coverage line booked on the job: no add.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Two vaults charged on a job whose coverage lines show a declared value of 7,500.00 carry 12.00 each, 24.00 in all.
